scripts.contracts:generate: uv run python scripts/generate_contracts.py && npm run contracts:types
scripts.contracts:types: openapi-typescript packages/contracts/generated/openapi.json -o packages/contracts/generated/api.ts && json2ts -i packages/contracts/generated/foundation.schema.json -o packages/contracts/generated/foundation.ts && json2ts -i packages/contracts/generated/clinical.schema.json -o packages/contracts/generated/clinical.ts
